schemas.name: inventory
schemas.description: Warehouses, product catalog, and stock levels

business_concepts.name: Customer
business_concepts.description: Registered buyer account with contact and billing details

business_concepts.name: Product
business_concepts.description: Catalog SKU item available for purchase

tables.name: customers
tables.description: Registered buyer accounts and profile metadata

tables.description: Customer order headers and fulfillment status

semantic_relationships.name: PLACED_BY_CUSTOMER
semantic_relationships.forward_description: Each order is placed by one registered customer account
semantic_relationships.reverse_description: A customer can place zero or many orders over time
semantic_relationships.description: [orders -> customers]: Each order is placed by one registered customer account | [customers -> orders]: A customer can place zero or many orders over time

semantic_relationships.name: BELONGS_TO_ORDER
semantic_relationships.forward_description: Each order line item belongs to one parent order header
semantic_relationships.reverse_description: An order header contains one or more purchased order line items
semantic_relationships.description: [order_items -> orders]: Each order line item belongs to one parent order header | [orders -> order_items]: An order header contains one or more purchased order line items

semantic_relationships.name: REFERENCES_PRODUCT
semantic_relationships.forward_description: Each order line item references a specific catalog product SKU
semantic_relationships.reverse_description: A catalog product can appear across many customer order line items
semantic_relationships.description: [order_items -> products]: Each order line item references a specific catalog product SKU | [products -> order_items]: A catalog product can appear across many customer order line items

common_join_paths.name: Full Customer Order Breakdown
common_join_paths.description: Joins customers, orders, line items, and products for revenue reporting
common_join_paths.sql:
SELECT
    c.email,
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.status,
    p.sku,
    p.name AS product_name,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price
FROM sales.orders o
JOIN sales.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN sales.order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN inventory.products p ON oi.product_id = p.id;
